scope: Independent review of nonlaunchable source-contract and configuration preparation only
verified: Existing frozen pilot source is not modified
Both source checkpoints pinned to exact bytes, epochs53/44, legacy selection, seed-specific configs and tensor schemas
Builder preserves the frozen model architecture and data/normalization source
Matched control and candidate retain identical source weights, learning rule, primary metric and within-seed order RNG
All existing config fields except explicitly listed source/seed/roster/round differences remain fixed
Generator emits specs only with GPU null and launch_enabled false; no runner or subprocess launch exists
Promotion record must name one candidate, immutable analysis evidence, seeds23/37, no test and no averaging, and a root-defined practical confirmation threshold
CPU_CHECKS source hashes independently rechecked against current files
Readme distinguishes synthetic order tests from actual data-order hashes and distinguishes conditional continuation from matched end-to-end budgets
required_before_any_future_fit: Root decision after full current-round analysis
Independent review of separate runtime source loader, namespace, source-contract/promotion pins, freeze and GPU assignments
Full validation epoch-zero replay for each source under the generalized runtime
Matched source/reset RNG and exact checkpoint transactions retained
Server-to-D archive followed by inspected commit/push and monitor registration
scientific_limits: Seed23/37 source runs had100-epoch budgets versus historical seed11's different budget; paired within-seed continuation effects are interpretable, absolute across-seed scores are not causal architecture comparisons
The reused validation split is not a fresh holdout

For a control-only schedule confirmation, comparing each independently trained source against its own epoch0 is appropriate; an identical duplicate control continuation would add no distinct treatment
O3 equivariance of the adapter is established, but electronic state-phase covariance is not implied
